title: Kirby Problem 3.35
exact_target: Compare the minimum number of fundamental-group generators with Heegaard genus: in rank-two hyperbolic manifolds, non-Haken manifolds, all closed orientable manifolds, arithmetic congruence covers, and knot exteriors.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2833 (KP-3.35). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 3.35, p. 156 and following remarks; original author version.
